svg.title: Unity implementation and project outcomes
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio, translated from the user-revised nine-page case study. Embedded 3840 x 2160 background with native editable text on a 2560 x 1440 canvas.

text.tspan: OUTCOME / UNITY DEVELOPMENT AND MY CONTRIBUTION
My role: all Unity development, interaction concept, selected UI work and user research.
XR poses, card contact and seat interactions feed the state machine.
Coordinate doors, seats, luggage paths and stage-based screens.
Research and cabin design, a web gesture prototype and the complete Quest journey.
Unity 2022.3 / C# / OpenXR / XR Interaction Toolkit
